topics.description: Recent investigations have uncovered significant fraud in Minnesota's child care program, prompting state officials to take action. The state's Department of Human Services (DHS) is working to identify and prevent fraudulent activities. This issue has gained attention following a report that Texas reviewed its child care spending and found little fraud, contrasting with the situation in Minnesota.
topics.reason: Minnesota's child care program is under scrutiny for fraud
